description: User requests regression test and confirmation only. Add deterministic same-widget first-load cookie/CSRF collision reproduction on existing branch; inspect and report concrete transport evidence. Do not implement session isolation redesign or unrelated WebKit fixes.

comments.text: Confirmed production cookie/CSRF collision without any production changes. Server-side diagnostic in SessionTest verifies both page tokens with their own cookie, then proves first token + last response cookie yields nil Phoenix connect_info.session and Socket :error for both websocket and longpoll. mix precommit passes 196 tests/no Credo issues; TypeScript check passes.
